title: Published Sanity suppression policy
goal: Explore a basket-building journey at the synthetic suppressed store and whether the customer can complete the order naturally without a prohibited cross-sell offer.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-06-sanity-suppression whose verified fulfillment state resolves to store KFCVN0036.
The public production dataset contains the published smart_cross_sell suppression policy for that store.
The role-player follows only customer-visible responses and observed actions.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Mình đặt một phần ăn tại cửa hàng gần đây rồi chốt đơn nhé.

risks: A suppressed placement must remain silent rather than being replaced by an ungoverned offer.
The evaluator needs protected policy-resolution evidence because absence in prose alone is ambiguous.
